spearman.name: Spearman
spearman.description: Cheap and sturdy. Holds a line against horsemen.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Shoots down slow spearmen from behind the line.

swordsman.name: Swordsman
swordsman.description: Armoured foot soldier, good at everything.

horseman.name: Horseman
horseman.description: Rides down archers. Fast, hard-hitting and hungry.

tools_comment: Siege tools, built in the Siege Workshop (one at a time from a queue like the barracks', faster by `time_per_barracks_level` each workshop level). Attack tools go with an attack, up to `tool_slots` per wall by your keep level, and are used up. Defence tools are posted on your walls in the Defence screen, up to `tool_slots` per wall by your wall level; they are lost only when their wall falls. Effects, each per tool at that wall: wall_cut takes that share off the wall's bonus (all of it at most); shield cuts what the defenders there deal (by half at most); moat makes the wall that much stronger; volley makes the defenders there deal that much more; scald cuts what the attackers there deal (by half at most). `walls` limits where a tool can go (the front wall is the gate).

ladder.name: Siege ladder
ladder.description: Gets your soldiers over the wall: each takes 8% off the wall's bonus where it is used.

mantlet.name: Mantlet
mantlet.description: A wheeled shield: the defenders on that wall deal 5% less damage per mantlet.

ram.name: Battering ram
ram.description: Breaks the gate: only at the front wall, each takes 20% off its bonus.

arrow_slits.name: Arrow slits
arrow_slits.description: Your defenders on that wall deal 5% more damage per arrow slit.

moat.name: Moat
moat.description: Water and stakes before the wall: it holds 5% stronger per section.

pitch.name: Boiling pitch
pitch.description: Poured on the climbers: attackers at that wall deal 5% less damage per cauldron.
